scope_label: Malaysia federal awards and state/royal award systems

sources.source_name: MedalBook — Malaysia federal and state catalogue
sources.content_coverage: Eight master index pages plus federal, territorial, state and nine sultanate category roots
sources.coverage_result: 607/607 object or grade pages and 89/89 exposed source images processed with no failures; four contact sheets reviewed; pictured records separated into eight awarding subjects.
All 54 embedded popup blocks inspected; 32 federal honour entries with 32 original official PNG images extracted, decoded and visually reviewed. Non-award announcement popups excluded.

sources.source_name: Malaysian state and royal official honours directories
sources.coverage_result: Official federal umbrella directory exhausted: 14 state or federal-territory sections and 282 precedence entries extracted. The umbrella page has no award images; individual state image catalogues remain queued. Perak and Perlis official sites and the Penang specification PDF timed out after finite retries.
